description: This file defines configuration options and a validator class for the Orleans reminder service, including properties for reminder periods and timeout, as well as validation logic with logging.

classes.name: ReminderOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the Orleans reminder service, including minimum reminder period, refresh period, and initialization timeout.

classes.name: ReminderOptionsValidator
classes.description: Internal class responsible for validating the ReminderOptions configuration, ensuring values are within acceptable ranges and logging warnings if necessary.

methods.name: ReminderOptions
methods.description: Constructor for the ReminderOptions class, initializes default values for reminder configuration properties.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the ReminderOptions values, throws exception if invalid, and logs warnings for low reminder intervals.

methods.name: LogWarnFastReminderInterval
methods.description: Partial method for logging a warning when the reminder interval is too short for production use.
